purpose: Default value of the user-matherr-handler slot [0x539A8]. A 5-byte JMP thunk that tail-transfers to the 'return 0' primitive at 0x4d8ea; returning 0 from a matherr handler signals 'I did not handle this error', so _matherr proceeds with its default diagnostic behaviour. _set_matherr overwrites the slot to install a custom handler, bypassing this thunk.
logic_summary: Single instruction: JMP 0x4d8ea (5-byte E9 form). No prologue/frame -- ESP reaches the target exactly as _matherr left it (exc still pushed). The target crt_equivalent_matherr_default_return_zero_4d8ea (PUSH EBP; MOV EBP,ESP; XOR EAX,EAX; POP EBP; RET) sets EAX=0 and RETs straight back to _matherr (caller cleans the cdecl arg via ADD ESP,4). Net effect at the call boundary: EAX=0, stack balanced. The thunk never reads exc. Its address is taken (it IS the default contents of slot [0x539A8], read+CALLed indirectly by _matherr at 0x4ccf9, written by _set_matherr), so it must remain a real callable function with its own PUBDEF, not folded away.

params.name: exc
params.semantics: Pointer to the matherr exception struct, passed by _matherr as a single cdecl stack arg (PUSH EBX where EBX=_matherr's own exc at [EBP+0xC], then CALL [0x539A8], ADD ESP,4). The thunk never dereferences it (JMPs straight through); it is declared only so the thunk's PUBDEF carries the correct cdecl signature for the slot.
params.reason: Name 'exc' accurately describes the matherr exception-struct pointer per the matherr ABI; no Ghidra address residue, not generic param_1. Matches the sibling crt_equivalent_matherr_default_return_zero_4d8ea param name.

returns.semantics: Always 0 (produced in EAX by the JMP target 0x4d8ea). 0 signals to _matherr 'handler did not handle this error', causing _matherr to run its default path (fputs diagnostic to stderr + __set_EDOM/__set_ERANGE + return the exception struct's pre-populated retval).
